## Notes

# European ash notes

The first pipeline run (fn-56, 2026-09-18) admitted the
manifest here and stopped at the missing diameter curve; its provenance,
decisions and resolutions are that run's. The packet profile is the complete
fn-34 research profile, not the run's two-metric draft, because the run never
reached generate. A later run of the select stage against this folder will
replace `packet/profile.json` with its own draft: the pipeline replaces a
packet record rather than merging into it, which is a gap worth its own spec.

There is no `european-ash` preset yet; the pins file is an empty stub until
fn-56 ships one.
